# Progress Update: [Milestone or Task]

**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Author:** [Person or AI agent]
**Branch/commit:** `[branch]` / `[commit]`
**Status:** [implemented | partial | planned | blocked | deferred]

## What changed

Describe the user-visible and technical changes in complete sentences. Identify the primary source files and documents.

## Why it changed

Explain the problem, decision, evidence, or requirement that led to the change. Link to a decision record or research note when applicable.

## Validation

| Check | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Focused tests | [pass/fail/not run] | [command or test name] |
| Full tests | [pass/fail/not run] | [command or CI URL] |
| Build/lint | [pass/fail/not run] | [command or CI URL] |
| CLI/API smoke | [pass/fail/not run] | [workflow or fixture] |
| Documentation review | [complete/incomplete] | [files reviewed] |

## Documentation synchronized

List the updated source-of-truth guides, status snapshot, changelog, diagrams, and research references. State explicitly if any expected document did not require a change and why.

## Known limitations and follow-up

State what is not proven, what remains unsafe or incomplete, and the next recommended action. Do not use “production-ready” unless the production-gap audit supports it.
